description: Secrets Manager Secret Policy Grants Access to Other Accounts
rationale: The resource policy allows named principals from AWS accounts other than the secret's owning account. Cross-account access may be intended, but it extends who can read the secret and must be reviewed. Wildcard grants are reported by secretsmanager-secret-policy-public; an unreadable policy is UNKNOWN.
remediation: Verify each external principal listed in the secret details is expected; remove grants that are not, and prefer role ARNs over account roots.
